title: Orange Glazed Northern Thai Chicken Skewers
description: A spicy and light Northern Thai dish featuring a sweet and sticky orange glaze, perfect for a date night, and diabetic-friendly due to the use of demerara sugar.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together demerara sugar, orange juice, fish sauce, lime juice, and Thai red curry paste to make the glaze.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the glaze.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the chicken skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Season the grilled chicken with salt and black pepper.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
Serve with additional orange glaze for dipping, if desired.
